name: Fold Club
thesis: A bright tactile paper toy shared around the table: the sheet’s real state—received, written, folded, opened—becomes the interface and the brand.

palette.roles: Cobalt is for deliberate action. Yellow is a rare accepted-paper accent, coral a small authored fold. Neither color is the only status signal.

type.source: Local bundled SIL OFL families via ../fonts.css
type.scale: Display 48–83px, view headings 36–64px, poem 18–25px, body 16px, supporting text 12–14px; input text at least 16px.

principles: One physical object, not a screenful of generic cards: the same paper changes state around the exact human game.
Spend boldness on the original accordion sculpture and folded-ribbon mark. Keep all editable and read-aloud text upright, plain and calm.
Plan before code: six-color paper/action system; Bricolage display and poem with DM Sans controls; left invitation facing a folded object, lobby stack, writing sheet, opened poem.

Pre-build critique rejected a repeated dog-eared-card grid: it would be a SaaS interface wearing paper. Replaced it with one stack for people, one sheet for writing and an unboxed annotation margin for practical actions.
Only confirmed acceptance can fold paper; loading and failure leave the current writing object intact.
Human words, not scores or novelty modes: preserve the exact nine-round target, previous-line-only writing and complete aloud reveal.
Privacy is material: keep a private full copy and disclose deliberate sharing scope separately. Never imply a local preview is real publication.
Silence, stillness, visible names, native input and large text are complete alternatives, not reduced-quality modes.
workflow: Enter as a guest through host or join; choose a name and optionally a cut-paper silhouette.
Gather at one shared roster stack. Invitation and host start remain legible; no role or account performance is required.
Write exactly 1,2,3,4,5,4,3,2,1 words over nine rounds. Only the previous line is visible. The local sketch requires a human to type every line and never generates contributions.
After accepted delivery, fold the sheet once and show named waiting status. The prototype labels manual advancement as a local mechanical-sketch control, not live multiplayer behavior.
Open the whole completed poem for a human reader, all nine lines together. Step-in and reread paths are clear.
Keep the session privately, reread complete poems, or explicitly preview sharing one poem or the entire set. No leaderboard or crown is retained.
Restart the sketch or leave through clear actions; every view/component/motion/sensory inventory ID is separately selectable through the common URL contract.
tradeoffs: Distinct even in grayscale because of actual sheet/stack/open-fold composition and original silhouette geometry, not merely pale-blue versus cobalt recoloring.
Strong mechanic-to-material fit makes this the most literal direction. Its risk is craft fussiness; the implementation deliberately removes grain, tape, rotations and nested paper cards.
Bricolage offers friendliness without a children’s toy voice, but big branding must quiet down for serious or tender human poems.
The complete poem can require normal scrolling on a small phone or large text. Preserving every line beats shrinking or clipping it to one screen.
Proposed workflow reopens recap competition: private heart acknowledgements replace the existing leader/crown ceremony, avoiding scoring pressure while retaining personal favorites.

No backend, real authentication, real room, production icon replacement or actual publication is implemented or implied. Native provider form subsets and server image rendering remain integration assumptions.
The downloadable fixture is a real local SVG with full text, not a claimed production PNG export. Native share/print/download behavior depends on browser support.

Rendered browser verification is recorded in verification.json: every inventory surface, the manually typed nine-round loop, both palettes, long content, 200% text, keyboard dialogs and reduced motion were exercised locally. Audio playback was invoked but not heard; real devices, assistive technology, account integration and live multiplayer remain outside this offline sketch.

views.composition: One continuous pale-blue table surrounds a single active paper object; the ribbon anchors the top left and practical navigation stays opposite.
views.hierarchy: Wordmark, current human task, then restrained utility links. The footer is a quiet return path, not a second action tray.
views.interaction: Header links navigate locally; appearance/help use a native focus-managed dialog. No overlay may hide essential recovery.
views.mobile: Header compresses to wordmark, help and settings; identity/archive remain available in footer and relevant views. All content reflows, with in-flow actions rather than fixed keyboard-obscuring trays.
views.motion: First paint is immediate. Only deliberate committed paper changes move.
views.copy: Made together. One line at a time.

views.composition: A big left-aligned invitation faces an original accordion paper sculpture. Three small sequential explanations run under a single baseline.
views.hierarchy: The plain two-line headline and host/join pair dominate; paper artwork illustrates the hidden-and-open mechanic, not decoration scattered across cards.
views.interaction: Host and join open distinct forms; the full nine-round mechanical sketch can also start from exploration controls.
views.mobile: Invitation and actions come first; a short horizontal paper sculpture follows, then the three instructions stack vertically.
views.motion: Home is still. The sculpture never floats or rotates on a loop.
views.copy: A little folded. A lot unexpected.

views.composition: A dog-eared room-creation sheet sits beside a quiet annotation with three cut-paper companions and the exact word pattern.
views.hierarchy: Pen name comes first, optional avatar second, create action at the bottom of the same sheet. Guest-first explanation is on the folded lower edge.
views.interaction: Whitespace-only names are rejected locally. Creating enters the sample lobby; pending/error/loading states retain an intelligible place and next action.
views.mobile: One unrotated sheet fills the narrow width. Name, avatar and submit remain in document flow above the explanatory aside.
views.motion: No form entrance animation; a joined seat may settle only after the action completes.

views.composition: The same entry sheet gains a code field above the pen name; invitation context is attached to the code, not a banner competing with the action.
views.hierarchy: Code, name, optional companion, join. An invitation fixture is visibly prefilled and read-only.
views.interaction: Manual codes normalize to four letters; the local FOLD invitation is explicitly not live. Errors keep the entered name and code on the sheet.
views.mobile: The code/name sequence remains vertical, with 16px input text and a single full-width bottom action reachable through native scrolling.
views.motion: Immediate focus and stable form geometry; no delayed scroll or flying code.

views.composition: One shared stack of three parallel sheets holds the roster. A detached ink-only invitation area sits to its right; no row becomes its own SaaS card.
views.hierarchy: Room status leads to named people, then the host action attached to the lower fold. Invitation and exact nine-round explanation are secondary.
views.interaction: Create/join leads here; start enters round one of the local human-written sketch. One-player, full, participant, away, pending and error states are separately selectable.
views.mobile: The stack becomes one narrow object with 7px and 14px offsets. The start action stays in the sheet; invitation follows rather than stealing the first screen.
views.motion: One small arrival settle, never a roster-wide stagger. Away writers do not pulse.

views.composition: A wide plain shared sheet pairs a large invitation destination with an original non-scannable QR layout specimen, then a named silhouette rail.
views.hierarchy: Invitation and human names are large enough for a room; Exit presentation is always visible and explicit.
views.interaction: Local join link opens the join sketch. QR art is labeled a composition specimen, never falsely presented as a working live invitation.
views.mobile: Presentation reflows rather than forcing a television ratio; the name rail wraps and long names break safely.
views.motion: Only a genuinely new seat would settle once; fixture presentation is still.

views.composition: One generous, upright white sheet. A narrow received-line fold sits above a quiet editor; the action belongs to the bottom fold, not a floating toolbar.
views.hierarchy: Round target, only the previous line, the new line and exact word count. No other poem lines or ornamental avatars invade the writing area.
views.interaction: Whitespace-separated exact counts gate sending; multiline input normalizes to one line, 500 characters maximum. The core sketch records nine manually typed human lines and exposes only the preceding one.
views.mobile: The target and nine-fold pattern wrap above the sheet. Browser scrolling keeps the textarea and in-flow action reachable with a software keyboard or 200% text.
views.motion: The editor never tilts, shakes or pulses. A fold is allowed only after local acceptance; pending and errors leave it open.
views.copy: Write 3 words. Follow the line in your own direction.

views.composition: The open editor becomes one clearly folded paper slip with a restrained yellow acknowledgement. A quiet named roster sits beside it.
views.hierarchy: Accepted status dominates; waiting people remain full-opacity names rather than crossed-out or competing players.
views.interaction: The core sketch offers an explicitly labeled local pass-to-next-round control; real group advancement is explained, not simulated with generated contributions. Host end-game confirmation is separate.
views.mobile: Sealed slip precedes a compact status list. There is no growing clock bar or sticky controls covering the people.
views.motion: One 550ms fold/settle after accepted delivery, then complete stillness. No repeating presence pulse.

views.composition: A folded waiting slip becomes an honest next-game invitation; the current human roster is visible to the side.
views.hierarchy: Watching-this-game explanation leads; no blank editor or disabled writing field implies a lost assignment.
views.interaction: A spectator can preview the completed reveal and enter normal writing only after restarting the game sketch.
views.mobile: Short message, a reveal action, then the roster; no dense instruction block before the explanation.
views.motion: No movement implies a spectator contribution. The paper remains folded until reveal.
views.copy: A seat for the next one.

views.composition: A shared paper stack holds one clear reader action while an ordered reading list sits outside it, like people around a table.
views.hierarchy: Current assignment and Unfold & read dominate. Named later readers have explicit text status; there is no race or leaderboard.
views.interaction: Assigned reading, fallback step-in, spectator, reread, pending, error and presentation alternatives each retain a clear action. Successful opening shows the entire poem.
views.mobile: Action stack precedes the reading circle; no horizontally scrolling assignment cards hide the next human.
views.motion: Opening a poem has one aperture. Reading rows do not arrive in a decorative queue.

views.composition: A complete open poem sheet occupies the right two-thirds; the left margin names the reader and holds finish/back controls.
views.hierarchy: All nine lines are the focal object. The title is modest, the reader is explicit, and attribution opens on deliberate selection.
views.interaction: All lines appear together with no line advancement. Favorite is a private keeper, attribution persists, and Finish reading leads to the private recap.
views.mobile: The reader and actions precede the sheet; all nine lines remain in one scrollable composition with long-word wrapping.
views.motion: One 600ms whole-sheet aperture at most, then stillness. Reduced motion shows every line immediately.

views.composition: A large complete poem sheet sits on an open blue table, with one compact reader heading and persistent exit/finish actions.
views.hierarchy: The full poem is dominant, not theatrical chrome or decorative avatars. Waiting-reader and empty states clearly reserve the same readable area.
views.interaction: Step-in opens the complete poem; Exit presentation returns to the circle; Finish poem returns to its overview.
views.mobile: The sheet becomes a normal scrollable page. Text never clips to enforce a presentation aspect ratio.
views.motion: No typewriter reveal, scroll recital or sound ceremony; only a short full-sheet opening.
views.copy: Every line is open. Read at your own pace.

views.composition: The completed poem is left open; a practical right margin separates private keeping, deliberate whole-session sharing and another game.
views.hierarchy: The words precede actions. No crown, live favorite leader or winning-poem ceremony competes with the human collection.
views.interaction: Poem tabs switch complete samples, reread returns to the poem, private-save feedback is truthful, sharing opens an explicit full-set warning, replay/exit are clear.
views.mobile: Open poem first, then the private-keeping and next-game actions. Narrow layouts do not collapse the complete poem into a teaser.
views.motion: The recap settles immediately; a private heart may press once. No leaderboard or crown burst.

views.composition: A centered plain-paper absence, using the folded sculpture once, with no broken-page visual noise.
views.hierarchy: Explain that the room may be closed, expired or inaccessible, then offer a new invitation path and home.
views.interaction: Return to join preserves a familiar next step; no guessed room content or fake membership recovery is displayed.
views.mobile: Compact art leaves room for the short explanation and two clear actions at phone size.
views.motion: Still; failures are not stamped in with a joke animation.

views.composition: An intact recovery sheet remains on the table, paired with a quiet folded-paper annotation.
views.hierarchy: Keep the draft and explain the failure before the retry action. The user is not blamed and the whole app does not disappear behind drama.
views.interaction: Loading and recovery alternatives route to an intact local room composition. Real query/render resets remain a production integration obligation.
views.mobile: A single sheet with stacked actions remains usable with long error text and no fixed overlay.
views.motion: No motion; preserving position matters more than an entrance.

views.composition: A named guest-seat recovery sheet in the same entry geometry, not an authentication dashboard.
views.hierarchy: Guest explanation, preserved identity, Try again. No account upgrade is presented as a fix for a connection error.
views.interaction: Loading is neutral; retry returns to guest entry in the local sketch without any credential request.
views.mobile: Short copy and full-width recovery action precede the decorative side note.
views.motion: Stable loading and immediate recovered state, never an endless spinner.

views.composition: A slim, high-contrast edge strip sits above the existing writing sheet; the draft remains visible and editable.
views.hierarchy: Offline/reconnecting/restored wording is primary. Sending is paused while offline; saved local words stay in place.
views.interaction: Local preview restoration updates the notice and leaves the draft on the same sheet. Healthy state explains that production would show no notice.
views.mobile: Notice wraps above, rather than over, the editor; recovery action never steals the entire writing viewport.
views.motion: No flash or repeated pulse. Restored state is a text acknowledgement, not an implied submission.
views.copy: You’re offline. Your draft stays here.

views.composition: A persistent folded-edge notice lives above the active paper without replacing the task.
views.hierarchy: Explain the new version and draft preservation before a reload choice. No surprise refresh.
views.interaction: Safe-reload preview is explicitly local. Healthy state has no production notice; a network failure alone must not claim staleness.
views.mobile: The notice takes natural height and cannot cover the line or commit action.
views.motion: Immediate, still notice with no periodic attention grab.
views.copy: A new version is ready. Your words come first.

views.composition: A paper folder composition: one fully open featured poem and a quiet vertical index of other folded slips, rather than a grid of identical cards.
views.hierarchy: The collection title, complete poem and readable saved-sheet titles lead; storage explanation is attached to the index.
views.interaction: All/favorites tabs switch local collection treatment; heart is private and reversible. Empty, loading, error, guest and account states remain explicit.
views.mobile: The featured complete poem comes before the index. Tabs and read actions remain visible without hover.
views.motion: No stagger, hover lift or animated silhouette. A stored poem feels available, not like a reward.
views.copy: A little collection of things you couldn’t have written alone.

views.composition: An open kept sheet with a left-hand margin for archive return, save, print and deliberate sharing.
views.hierarchy: Full text precedes secondary operations. Public-enabled state exposes revoke separately from private save.
views.interaction: Favorite toggles locally; image download and print are real browser actions for the sketch. No saved/private action activates a public link.
views.mobile: Controls stack above the complete sheet; author names wrap and remain readable.
views.motion: The kept sheet is still; no reread ceremony or clipping.

views.composition: The same complete open sheet, stripped of participant-only favorite and revoke controls; unavailable links become a neutral private fallback.
views.hierarchy: Permission-aware public text or a quiet non-disclosing absence. No private teaser leaks through loading or revoke states.
views.interaction: Pending shows preparation; private/revoked show no lines; authorized fixture offers start, save, print and design-sketch sharing only.
views.mobile: One readable sheet with plain actions; error/private alternatives keep the same comfortable type scale.
views.motion: No opening animation while authorization is unknown. Public text appears as a whole once allowed.

views.composition: The complete poem remains left, while a right-hand decision margin explains scope and the private-until-delivered lifecycle.
views.hierarchy: Disclosure before action. Prepared, delivered, canceled, failed and revoked state previews are named as sketches, never live publication.
views.interaction: Explicit local success/cancel/failure controls illustrate the lifecycle; native OS UI is not imitated. Revoke returns the preview to private.
views.mobile: The poem and sharing explanation stack; warning and Keep it private remain visible before any delivery action.
views.motion: No success stamp before delivery. State changes are immediate and text-confirmed.

views.composition: The same permission margin is expanded to a visible whole-session set with a second folded poem reference.
views.hierarchy: Every-poem scope is the headline, not footnote. Sharing one poem and all poems are visibly different decisions.
views.interaction: Previewed delivered/canceled/error states never claim live publication. Keep it private returns to the recap.
views.mobile: Full-set explanation precedes the delivery controls, with enough room for long human attribution.
views.motion: No generic confetti or celebratory publication effect.

views.composition: The whole attributed sheet is shown beside a private-copy explanation and one download action.
views.hierarchy: Complete lines, full author names, then save. Public-link control is deliberately absent from this operation.
views.interaction: The sketch builds a local SVG image with wrapped lines; browser saving is real. Pending/saved/canceled/error treatments never invent backend success.
views.mobile: All lines remain readable in the preview; the downloadable image grows with line wrapping rather than cropping.
views.motion: Stable preparation, no progress percentage without measured progress.

views.composition: Plain ink on white carries the whole poem and attribution; the on-screen decision area is removed by print CSS.
views.hierarchy: Human lines and contributor names only on paper. No exploration or action chrome travels with the artifact.
views.interaction: The real browser print surface owns settings and cancellation. No custom print-dialog imitation.
views.mobile: Preview reflows naturally; printed output is plain, untruncated and not tied to phone dimensions.
views.motion: No motion in print or preparation.

views.composition: A linear collection of complete sheets with explicit session scope, contributor attribution and a practical print margin.
views.hierarchy: All poems are available together rather than one teaser and hidden remainder. Unavailable sessions disclose no lines.
views.interaction: Print includes the complete set; local start/new-room actions remain clear. Publication is an explicit fixture, not inferred from the route.
views.mobile: Complete sheets stack with generous reading measure; long collections use native page flow and print page breaks.
views.motion: No staggered entrance across many poems; every sheet is immediately available.

views.composition: A clean account sheet faces one folded-paper invitation on desktop; mobile gives the form all attention.
views.hierarchy: Account benefit and provider-owned form remain plain. Guest continuation is a real peer action, not a faint escape hatch.
views.interaction: Local sample email/verification transitions demonstrate composition only; no password or authentication request is accepted. Local mode explains unavailable accounts truthfully.
views.mobile: Single form-first column. No cramped split or giant art before inputs.
views.motion: No spinner dependency or marketing animation; pending retains shape and next-state explanation.

views.composition: Account creation uses the same confident paper form with guest-first explanation and optional public words outside the input area.
views.hierarchy: No account requirement is implied for playing. Cross-device private collection is the only account benefit claimed in the sketch.
views.interaction: Sample continuation and verification remain local. Provider-specific recovery/security screens are unverified integration assumptions, not fake completed features.
views.mobile: Form-first, 16px fields and in-flow continue/guest choices.
views.motion: Stable form geometry; no celebratory account-created confetti.
views.copy: Create an account. Or keep playing.

views.composition: An intact guest-poem transfer sheet reserves the content area and explains what remains safe if the transfer fails.
views.hierarchy: Preserved guest poems and retry/home options outrank the identity-provider operation.
views.interaction: Loading, migration failure, success and local-account-unavailable sketches are distinct; none claims a real transfer.
views.mobile: Short copy and stacked retry/home actions fit a phone without an auth spinner taking over.
views.motion: Still placeholders; no indefinite rotation or timed fake success.

views.composition: A large cut-paper portrait has a straight name slip; editing and account status live in an unboxed column beside it.
views.hierarchy: Human name first, optional silhouette second, private-account context third. No miniature account dashboard.
views.interaction: Name editing and avatar selection update this page only; account and local guest states are separate and truthful.
views.mobile: Portrait is a short wide object above form controls. Long names break rather than shrink to illegibility.
views.motion: The avatar remains in color at rest; no hover reveal or looping pose.
views.copy: A name. A little paper you.

views.composition: A familiar name-slip portrait sits beside a plain provider-control sheet with explicit return and sign-out actions.
views.hierarchy: Identity, account ownership, then safe exit. Guest/local accounts have an explanation rather than nonfunctional controls.
views.interaction: Manage/change/sign-out are labeled local state previews; no integrated provider UI is fabricated.
views.mobile: Portrait and controls stack with large targets; the account area scrolls normally.
views.motion: No avatar hover filter or popover choreography needed for meaning.

views.composition: A compact four-step paper guide shows the true nine-count fold pattern before practical instructions.
views.hierarchy: The mechanical rule and previous-line privacy outrank lore. No score, prompt, AI author or new mode is introduced.
views.interaction: Inline view and native dialog both exist; Escape, backdrop, close and Got it return focus to the trigger.
views.mobile: Native dialog has bounded height and scroll; instruction text scales and actions remain reachable.
views.motion: At most 180ms opacity, no decorative step-by-step entrance.

views.composition: One paper utility sheet groups paper mode, motion, optional paper tick and silhouette choice without rearranging the game.
views.hierarchy: Readability and comfort first. Sound explicitly starts off; OS reduced motion cannot be overridden off.
views.interaction: Light/dark/system control, switches, explicit audio enable/play and avatar buttons are usable in a native dialog and inline specimen.
views.mobile: Rows wrap in a bounded dialog, with native selects and large switches; no portal cut-off at the phone keyboard.
views.motion: Mode changes are direct. Reduced mode leaves every complete state visible.

views.composition: An editorial side title faces a linear run of paper-edge release entries, not announcement cards.
views.hierarchy: Plain product changes precede optional technical details; dates are secondary and sample status is explicit.
views.interaction: Native details opens technical context; home and feed return paths remain visible.
views.mobile: Title and entries stack; long technical text wraps in its own disclosure.
views.motion: No release-card stagger or delayed reveal.

views.composition: A reader-friendly plain feed composition demonstrates title, dated entries and stable links, without pretending to control an external RSS app.
views.hierarchy: Version/date/product content is linear, with home and full-release paths.
views.interaction: Local feed preview is explicit; external RSS rendering is acknowledged as platform-owned.
views.mobile: One readable column mirrors how content survives outside the product.
views.motion: No motion or custom external-reader chrome.

views.composition: A compact missing sheet on the open blue table, not a fixed full-screen stamp-and-grain scene.
views.hierarchy: A plain missing-page statement and Return home, with no leaked private recap context.
views.interaction: Home is a reliable local action; the error is not a game failure or joke at the user’s expense.
views.mobile: Small illustration leaves enough first-screen space for the message and action.
views.motion: No 404 stamp, shake, blur or entrance delay.

views.composition: The current paper language narrows to one safe recovery sheet with a clear retry/home boundary.
views.hierarchy: What failed, what remains intact, next action. No technical stack trace or generic apology.
views.interaction: Retry is a local recovered-state preview; production reset is an integration obligation.
views.mobile: Natural content height accommodates long errors and large text without a fixed overlay.
views.motion: Still. Recovery feedback is not a celebration.

views.composition: A plain standalone readable sheet expresses the identity even if runtime wrappers cannot initialize.
views.hierarchy: Human recovery text and a safe action need no avatar, account provider or effect.
views.interaction: Local sketch shows the fallback composition; real root-document reset remains unverified.
views.mobile: Minimal layout and system-compatible fallbacks tolerate unavailable fonts and small viewports.
views.motion: No motion or provider-dependent effect.

views.composition: A wide invitation print pairs the big Fold Club phrase with the original accordion sculpture and ribbon, retaining identifiable geometry in grayscale.
views.hierarchy: Brand and game promise, then nine-fold object. No fake user poem or remote reference artwork.
views.interaction: Artwork is a static composition sketch; downstream server image generation is not claimed.
views.mobile: The specimen scales to narrow width without changing the export’s intentional wide composition; type wraps instead of cropping.
views.motion: Static image.
views.copy: A little folded. A lot unexpected.

views.composition: A clean public teaser print carries human text only when explicitly public; private state becomes the ribbon and folded paper without any poem text.
views.hierarchy: Permission first, short teaser second, modest contributor context. No private content in generic fallback.
views.interaction: Public/private and long-text specimen states are explicit; actual authorization remains backend-owned.
views.mobile: Preview text wraps, and the full-poem artifact remains a different surface from this teaser.
views.motion: Static image with no implied unsealing before permission.

views.composition: A broad session print places the ribbon above an evening title and two folded poem references; private state removes all poem references.
views.hierarchy: Whole-session identity and sample count distinguish it from single-poem sharing.
views.interaction: Public/private previews are selectable without publishing anything.
views.mobile: Folded references wrap vertically on a narrow specimen while retaining their distinct full-set role.
views.motion: Static; no carousel of private teasers.

components.treatment: The open blue table, local type and one active paper object define a coherent shell across guest, account, play and artifact contexts.
components.states: Prepaint uses an explicit light/dark palette; loading reserves shape, failure leaves a readable recovery sheet, and print strips application chrome.
components.accessibility: Skip link, natural reading order, large-text reflow, OS reduced motion and platform color behavior do not depend on optional services.

components.treatment: Original folded-ribbon wordmark at left; plain labeled navigation and a outlined settings tool at right. No replicated mini-dashboard.
components.states: Guest/account entries differ honestly; narrow chrome reduces secondary density without hiding help, appearance or route-return actions.
components.accessibility: Minimum 40–44px touch targets, named icon, visible focus and functional native-dialog return focus.

components.treatment: One quiet baseline carries a human phrase and practical identity/release/exit links.
components.states: Normal pages show a low-priority footer; print removes it. It never becomes a second sticky action toolbar.
components.accessibility: Links remain text, wrap at 200% text and retain visible keyboard focus.

components.treatment: A graphic invitation and original accordion paper object, followed by three real sequential instructions.
components.states: First visit and returning state retain the same obvious host/join pair; no account-gated game entry.
components.accessibility: Text precedes decorative art in DOM order; actions wrap naturally and have large hit areas.

components.treatment: One dog-eared name sheet with optional silhouette choices and a folded action boundary.
components.states: Empty name, long name, guest loading, create pending and preserved-input error states use the same paper object.
components.accessibility: Associated name label, autocomplete nickname, native validity and a normal scrolling action.

components.treatment: Code and name form on a single upright sheet, with the invitation explanation attached to the code.
components.states: Manual four-letter normalized code, read-only invitation fixture, loading, pending and actionable error states stay distinct.
components.accessibility: Code label, character capitalization, readonly semantics, native required validation and no clipboard requirement.

components.treatment: The room changes the physical state of one sheet: stack, received line, folded receipt, opened poem.
components.states: Loading, unavailable, lobby, writing, waiting and completed states have actual different compositions, not color-only switches.
components.accessibility: Phase headings, local focus movement and explicit recovery remain readable without motion.

components.treatment: An intact recovery sheet replaces an unknown room phase without inventing game content.
components.states: Unknown status offers a safe home/room recovery; no fictional partial poem is shown.
components.accessibility: Plain explanatory text and independent large recovery buttons work without runtime-dependent art.

components.treatment: A small shared stack contains all roster rows, with invitation information outside the stack.
components.states: One through eight people, host/participant, away, long names, pending and failed start have named status and anchored actions.
components.accessibility: Names are primary; avatars and color are supplementary. No horizontal overflow or animation-only arrivals.

components.treatment: One calm writing object with a narrow previous-line fold and attached commit edge.
components.states: Assignment loading, no-assignment spectator, active editor and accepted wait are visually different truthful phases.
components.accessibility: Only previous line in the editor; no hidden whole-poem DOM fixture, native textarea and large-text flow.

components.treatment: The textarea is plain, generous and upright. Small paper slots below it report the exact target, never taste or quality.
components.states: Blank, under, exact, over, restored draft, pending, error, offline and final-round variants preserve the current words and gate only exact counts.
components.accessibility: Native textarea, 500-character limit, whitespace normalization, live word count and no keystroke animation or sound.

components.treatment: The line folds into a quiet acknowledgement slip beside an undimmed roster.
components.states: Loading, partly accepted, ready, away and spectator names are explicit; end-game confirmation is a separate warning block.
components.accessibility: No strikethrough players, pulsing rings or urgency race. Accepted text and named status convey every state silently.

components.treatment: One assigned folded poem and one ordered human reading circle, not a wall of teaser cards.
components.states: Assigned/fallback reader, spectator, pending, failed opening and reread retain distinct practical actions.
components.accessibility: Reader names and status text are explicit; opening focuses a readable heading and never relies on timed content.

components.treatment: The complete opened sheet has modest metadata, nine left-aligned lines, and attribution on the lower fold.
components.states: In-room, archive and public permission contexts differ by controls; favorite, error and persistent attribution are visible without hovering.
components.accessibility: All lines appear together, long words wrap, no line animation gate, and contributor names persist until dismissed.

components.treatment: A full poem remains open beside a private-keep/share/another-game margin.
components.states: Empty favorite and chosen favorite do not generate a leader; whole-session sharing and rematch errors use clear text feedback.
components.accessibility: No crown or ranking; full poems, explicit privacy scope, large replay/exit actions and silence remain complete.

components.treatment: An open full-viewport table contains one large sheet and a compact explicit exit control.
components.states: Lobby, no-poem, waiting-reader, active full poem and finished overview share readable stage geometry.
components.accessibility: Natural scroll on narrow screens; exit is never hover-only or hidden behind the poem.

components.treatment: Large invitation destination and named paper silhouettes make the room legible at a distance.
components.states: Arrival, host, away and eight-seat capacity are named; QR art is explicitly non-scannable in this design sketch.
components.accessibility: Long names wrap and the invitation has an ordinary text/link alternative.

components.treatment: A sharp dark/light QR-position specimen sits beside readable local invitation context.
components.states: Local destination and non-scannable fixture status are explicit. No fake working live code is presented.
components.accessibility: Accessible image description says non-scannable; the usable Open local join sketch action is the equivalent path.

components.treatment: The whole poem is the stage; reader identity and finish/back actions stay outside its reading measure.
components.states: Empty, waiting-reader, step-in, pending, failure, active and reread variants avoid falsely opening unknown poems.
components.accessibility: Every line stays available together with natural scrolling and no sound dependency.

components.treatment: One compact local-room identifier, named presence and Room tools disclosure above the active sheet.
components.states: Code/invitation tooling is labeled sketch-only; copying reports actual clipboard completion or failure.
components.accessibility: Tools are labeled buttons in natural tab order; QR/help/appearance use focus-managed native dialog.

components.treatment: A quiet settings trigger opens the same paper utility sheet without introducing separate entry-only controls.
components.states: Open/closed appearance, sound and avatar choices share one coherent panel.
components.accessibility: Native dialog Escape/backdrop behavior, bounded height and trigger-focus restoration.

components.treatment: Native appearance choices use named paper palettes rather than a decorative moon/sun switch alone.
components.states: Light, blue-hour dark and current-system application have explicit selected state; unavailable persistence is not faked.
components.accessibility: Native select keyboard behavior and readable noninverted palettes; OS motion reduction remains authoritative.

components.treatment: A compact paper guide shows exact nine-fold shape and four practical human steps.
components.states: Open/closed native dialog, close button, Got it and Escape are all actual interactions.
components.accessibility: Native modal focus containment, scrollable bounded height, sentence case and a real close target.

components.treatment: A left-edged connection strip lives above the still-present writing sheet.
components.states: Healthy absence, offline, reconnecting and restored text do not imply an accepted submission.
components.accessibility: Status is text with a live region; it never covers the draft or relies only on yellow.

components.treatment: A persistent update fold asks for a deliberate safe reload rather than stealing the page.
components.states: Current/unknown means no production notice; stale preview names draft preservation and reload choice.
components.accessibility: No automatic refresh, flashing or time pressure; warning and action remain keyboard reachable.

components.treatment: The affected phase becomes an intact paper recovery area while keeping room context intelligible.
components.states: Error explains preservation and recovery; loading and recovered composition are not generic whole-page blackouts.
components.accessibility: Plain language, meaningful heading and native buttons remain usable without decorative assets.

components.treatment: Guest-seat recovery uses the same cared-for paper as entry, without pushing account registration.
components.states: Custom guest failure message and retry live together; the local sketch never claims a credential request.
components.accessibility: Error is a readable alert with one clear retry path and safe home alternative.

components.treatment: A guest-welcome sheet explains that local accounts are disconnected.
components.states: Local mode offers guest play rather than dead provider buttons or fake account identity.
components.accessibility: All explanation is text; Play as guest is a normal large button with no login gate.

components.treatment: One featured open poem and a folded vertical index replace a generic equal-card grid.
components.states: Loading, error, empty, guest/account and favorite collection treatment each has a real composition.
components.accessibility: No hover-only read controls; complete poem readability, native tabs and long-name wrapping.

components.treatment: Storage scope is an ink-only note associated with the collection, not a marketing banner.
components.states: Guest notes browser-only preservation; account notes cross-device private keeping. No poems or signed-in claims are fabricated.
components.accessibility: Clear text distinguishes private saving from publication and browser lifetime from account lifetime.

components.treatment: Four modest collection facts sit on one baseline; no cards, charts or competition metrics.
components.states: Poems, private favorites, collaborators and authored lines use real semantic definition-list shape and illustrative fixture values.
components.accessibility: Text labels survive color loss; values are selectable and can wrap at large text.

components.treatment: One plainly named count is typeset as a collection fact, not a reward tile.
components.states: Ordinary and emphasized facts differ by type weight, not a success color or rank.
components.accessibility: Semantic term/value pairing; label is always visible and never an icon alone.

components.treatment: Four static line-length placeholders reserve the factual layout.
components.states: Loading remains named; no invented progress percentage or pulsing implication of liveness.
components.accessibility: One status label, decorative shapes aria-hidden, no animation dependency.

components.treatment: An actually open saved sheet with full text and an always-visible read action.
components.states: Default/featured do not change privacy; favorite and failure are explicit, with no hover lift or hidden action.
components.accessibility: Native button, full poem readability and visible actions for touch, keyboard and zoom.

components.treatment: The same paper geometry reserves title, line and footer space with still folds.
components.states: Loading is visibly incomplete and named, never a generic empty content card.
components.accessibility: One loading announcement instead of every decorative rectangle in the accessibility tree.

components.treatment: A small folded object precedes a direct invitation to make the first human poem.
components.states: Default and no-favorites emptiness have distinct next actions; no fictitious poem is inserted to avoid an empty screen.
components.accessibility: Short helpful text and host/join actions; no shame or progress gamification.

components.treatment: An original accordion sculpture and exact numeric nine-fold rail express the 1–2–3–4–5–4–3–2–1 form.
components.states: Large/medium use the same honest silhouette; empty and hover states do not animate individual bars.
components.accessibility: Visible numeric sequence and an accessible description mean shape is never the sole rules explanation.

components.treatment: The compact option is the exact nine-fold rail, not a second ornamental diamond vocabulary.
components.states: Shown as an explicitly optional unmounted composition specimen; no new game control is implied.
components.accessibility: Numbers and full pattern label remain readable without animation or color.

components.treatment: Small original cut-paper silhouettes are paired with visible contributor names, replacing color-only dots.
components.states: Named contributors can be activated for explicit attribution; more names should wrap, not disappear behind tiny overflow markers.
components.accessibility: Buttons have full text names and large targets; shape/color only supplement stable human attribution.

components.treatment: Inline attribution is normal readable human names, not a gradient underline.
components.states: The unmounted optional treatment is demonstrated without inventing a new production consumer; empty attribution would add no ornament.
components.accessibility: Screen readers receive the actual names in text; no hover or color decoding required.

components.treatment: An open complete sheet with private-keeping controls in a margin.
components.states: Participant/public/pending/revoked/loading/favorite states gate content and controls, not just appearance.
components.accessibility: Full poem, persistent attribution and explicit privacy states remain readable in light/dark and large text.

components.treatment: Every complete poem is a separate open sheet in one linear session document.
components.states: Public fixture and unavailable fallback are distinct; no private preview leaks into the unavailable branch.
components.accessibility: All authors and lines are present, native page flow handles long collections, and print removes chrome.

components.treatment: A plainly labeled print action promises the whole session, not a decorative download glyph.
components.states: Native print is invoked after the complete recap is composed; cancellation is platform-owned and changes no privacy state.
components.accessibility: Text label, large target, real browser surface and print-only content rules.

components.treatment: The account form is one quiet sheet; an original paper object or opted-in public poem is an outside annotation.
components.states: Desktop two-part composition becomes form-first single column; local guest-only branch is real.
components.accessibility: No remote photo, inaccessible side marketing or required avatar; guest continuation remains visible.

components.treatment: A provider-form composition sketch uses plain email/verification fields on paper, with guest continuation.
components.states: Local, pending, error and verification fixtures are labeled not live; no real password is requested.
components.accessibility: Native input labels/validation and 16px type. Real provider-enabled surface details remain unverified.

components.treatment: Creation is framed as optional private-collection continuity, never admission to the game.
components.states: Sample local email/verification path and disconnected-account fallback both preserve guest play.
components.accessibility: Large native inputs, explicit non-live fixture warning and keyboard-operable guest route.

components.treatment: A stable paper transfer surface explains guest-poem preservation before authentication machinery.
components.states: Loading, failure, retry, success and local-unavailable states are separately rendered; no fake real migration.
components.accessibility: Failure does not erase guest context; next actions are readable and independently focusable.

components.treatment: One full human poem may sit beside the account sheet, never private archive snippets or stock artwork.
components.states: The exploration uses an explicit synthetic substitute; production must use only an opted-in public poem or honest empty state.
components.accessibility: Readable full lines and attribution; no autoplay carousel, disappearing text or private data in art.

components.treatment: A cut-paper portrait and straight name slip sit beside simple identity editing.
components.states: Guest/account/local/long-name treatments are explicit; optional photo is not required for recognition.
components.accessibility: Name is primary, silhouette optional, and color stays visible at rest rather than appearing only on hover.

components.treatment: Linear paper-edge entries with a side heading preserve reading flow outside the game.
components.states: Empty/loaded states and a feed-preview link are clearly labeled illustrative content, not actual shipped release evidence.
components.accessibility: Normal headings, native disclosure and wide measure that collapses to one readable column.

components.treatment: An unboxed dated fold carries one product change and optional technical context.
components.states: Product prose stays visible; technical details are a native disclosure, not a hidden hover state.
components.accessibility: Semantic time and heading, large summary hit area, no staggered reveal.

components.treatment: A plain native details element keeps technical scope below the human-facing change.
components.states: Collapsed and expanded alternatives are real controls with honest exploration-only content.
components.accessibility: Browser-managed keyboard interaction and expanded-state semantics; no custom disclosure ARIA choreography.

components.treatment: A single missing-page sheet uses the paper sculpture sparingly and leaves room for the return action.
components.states: 404 is not a dramatic stamp, grain field or full-screen effect; unavailable private context remains undisclosed.
components.accessibility: Short plain text, visible home action, natural mobile height and no motion.

components.treatment: A clear retry sheet in the existing identity, not a separate error design language.
components.states: Caught/recovery states retain useful words and a safe home path; local reset is labeled a preview.
components.accessibility: No technical details required for action, no fixed overlay, large readable recovery controls.

components.treatment: Minimal paper recovery remains understandable without the normal provider shell.
components.states: Root failure has one plain safe action; no assumed account/image/effect availability.
components.accessibility: System-compatible type fallback and a real heading/action can survive unavailable local fonts.

components.treatment: Cobalt filled primary actions, paper-and-line secondary actions and quiet text-bound alternatives. Small straight corner radius, not pill soup.
components.states: Pressed moves down 2px; disabled is explicit; error/retry uses text plus a colored edge. Success is never announced on press alone.
components.accessibility: 52px primary height, visible focus, native disabled and no hold-to-submit or icon-only unlabeled action.

components.treatment: Plain upright paper field with a crisp edge and generous type, no floating label or decorative inset.
components.states: Empty/filled/focus/readonly/disabled/error examples retain labels and appropriate native semantics.
components.accessibility: 16px minimum field text, associated label, explicit error description, safe long input and native keyboard behavior.

components.treatment: Sentence-case DM Sans with useful emphasis and ordinary tracking; labels explain the field rather than decorate the sheet.
components.states: Normal and important labels differ modestly in weight, never in coded color alone.
components.accessibility: Actual label-for association; no all-caps monospaced text or placeholder-only naming.

components.treatment: A paper notice with one meaningful colored left edge; message and next action share the same block.
components.states: Error, warning, success and information are text-labeled; draft-preservation error never disappears as a transient toast alone.
components.accessibility: Role alert/status as appropriate, visible title and readable action; color supplements the words.

components.treatment: Original Kite, Fox, Wren and Whale cut-paper silhouettes, each with a distinct outline and crease.
components.states: Optional selection has a border and Selected text. Names remain stable and no collectible/unlock is implied.
components.accessibility: Visible names, pressed state and generous button area; distinguishable in grayscale and removable from meaning.

components.treatment: A small outlined Host text label, without a crown or hierarchical character pose.
components.states: Both modes preserve plain text. Authority is a practical role, not a scoring ornament.
components.accessibility: Real word Host rather than icon-only meaning, and no dependency on color.

components.treatment: A named still paper surface reserves the expected text space.
components.states: Room setup, joining, passing, unsealing and transfer use task-specific wording without fake measurable progress.
components.accessibility: One polite status announcement and stable layout; no endless spinner or motion-only activity.

components.treatment: Small elapsed-time language sits below the waiting roster rather than draining above the writer.
components.states: Absent start would render nothing; elapsed and overtime remain soft, never become a deadline or disable writing.
components.accessibility: Text alternative, no urgent warm-zone color or animated narrowing bar; no repeated live time announcement.

components.treatment: Replace the rubber-stamp flourish with one small parallel paper settle after a human arrives.
components.states: Before is no seat; after is the named present seat. No delayed stagger across the roster.
components.accessibility: Replay button and immediate reduced-motion result; visible arrival text outlasts the effect.

components.treatment: Small rectangular paper folds count whitespace-separated words beneath the actual textarea.
components.states: Empty, under, exact and overflow have numeric text; overflow says how many to remove instead of rendering an unbounded chip cloud.
components.accessibility: Live exact count, stable native textarea and no visual-only slot judgment; long words do not expand the layout.

components.treatment: A simple outlined heart keeps a poem privately, without turning it into a ranked object.
components.states: Selected is filled with pressed semantics; a failed update keeps the previous state and reports an actionable error.
components.accessibility: 44px target, descriptive accessible name and text feedback; no unknown optimistic success claim.

components.treatment: A wide Fold Club invitation print uses the original ribbon and accordion sculpture, not a generic circle mark.
components.states: Fixed-artwork public identity and font-fallback tolerance; no user content is implied.
components.accessibility: High-contrast readable type and meaningful alternative description; no remote image or font dependency.

components.treatment: Short authorized public text on clean paper, clearly different from a whole-poem export.
components.states: Public preview and long-text specimen wrap deliberately; private/pending must use the separate generic fallback.
components.accessibility: Permission boundary precedes rendering; legible text, no inaccessible cropped attribution claim.

components.treatment: A closed folded object and non-disclosing Linejam phrase replace unavailable poem content.
components.states: Private, pending, revoked and unavailable use no actual lines or participant names.
components.accessibility: Meaning is plain text, not an ambiguous locked illustration; privacy survives every mode.

components.treatment: A complete open attributed sheet in the chosen readable mode, without application action chrome.
components.states: Image height grows with wrapped lines; every human line and author name belongs in the full artifact.
components.accessibility: No cropping, no teaser substitution, and no publication side effect from private saving.

components.treatment: Whole-session title and two folded poem references distinguish the set from one poem.
components.states: Public preview uses explicit sample metadata; private state removes every poem reference.
components.accessibility: Readable set scope, conservative authorization boundary and no automatic carousel or leaked private text.

motion.choreography: OS reduction and the local override remove all spatial and opacity animation; every state is already at its readable endpoint.
motion.reducedMotion: The complete poem, accepted state and named presence appear immediately. Sound is independently optional and never a substitute.

motion.choreography: Apply the alternate authored paper palette directly, without a page-wide color tween or inverse-image flash.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical immediate switch. Illustrations use authored fill tokens in both palettes.

motion.choreography: Use natural flow and browser viewport behavior rather than translated fixed trays. The action belongs to the sheet.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical layout. Software keyboard and large-text changes never require an animation to expose the action.

motion.choreography: Focus the textarea normally; let the browser scroll the minimum needed. Round transitions focus the new phase heading without a delayed jump.
motion.reducedMotion: Same native focus and immediate necessary scrolling; editor remains upright.

motion.choreography: An enabled action travels down 2px while pressed, then returns. This means contact, not acceptance.
motion.reducedMotion: No travel; focus, active styling and native button semantics remain.

motion.choreography: A newly present paper silhouette settles vertically by 14px into the stack, with no rotation or scale-from-zero stamp.
motion.reducedMotion: The name and Here status appear immediately in the same reserved row.

motion.choreography: Replace spinning and pulsing with stable named paper skeletons that preserve the eventual reading geometry.
motion.timing: 0ms loops; real completion controls the change.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical static loading state and explicit task-specific status.

motion.choreography: Retire general-purpose fade-and-rise entrances. Ordinary words should be readable at first paint.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical immediate content, including errors, help copy and archive sheets.

motion.choreography: Keep saved paper flat. The read action and full text are visible at rest, with an ordinary focus outline instead of hover lift.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical; no hover-only detail or reveal badge is lost.

motion.choreography: The nine-fold object is complete at rest. Hover does not build, unbuild or perform the poem’s structure.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical complete pattern with a text description of the exact counts.

motion.choreography: Replace hover-only scaling with deliberate named contributor selection. Names stay open until the person dismisses them.
motion.reducedMotion: Same persistent names and accessible button labels.

motion.choreography: Remove repeated active-writer rings. Each person has an undimmed name and literal Writing, Away or Line accepted status.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical complete presence information. No slow writer is made into a throbbing target.

motion.choreography: Remove shrinking pace bars and urgency warming. Modest elapsed-time language is separate from the editor and never gates submission.
motion.timing: No visual animation; optional coarse elapsed text.
motion.reducedMotion: Same text; no deadline semantics or live-region ticking.

motion.choreography: Each counted word fills one small paper fold immediately. Over-target text names the count to remove; no shake or reward bounce.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical numeric and filled-state feedback; color is redundant.

motion.choreography: Retire the infinite ready halo. Exactly matching the word target enables Fold & send and adds plain Ready wording.
motion.reducedMotion: Same enabled action and live count. Motion is not used to pressure a submission.

motion.choreography: Only accepted delivery permits one shallow perspective fold and a named accepted slip. Pending or failure leaves the writing sheet open.
motion.timing: 550ms once, then still; no fake latency masking.
motion.reducedMotion: Immediate accepted slip with explicit acknowledgement. The next-round control remains available in the local sketch.

motion.choreography: A selected contributor explanation may appear with a brief opacity change but never expires on a two-second reading deadline.
motion.reducedMotion: Immediate readable names with the same dismiss action and focus order.

motion.choreography: A native modal paper guide opens without moving underlying content; Escape, backdrop and close restore trigger focus.
motion.timing: At most 180ms opacity; no staged instructions.
motion.reducedMotion: Immediate open/close with native focus containment and return.

motion.choreography: Room tools and comfort controls open as a compact paper utility panel, without moving the writing sheet.
motion.timing: At most 180ms opacity; controls respond immediately.
motion.reducedMotion: Immediate panel with the same dialog lifecycle and bounded scrolling.

motion.choreography: A single whole-sheet aperture opens to all nine lines, followed by stillness. Focus announces the reader and complete poem, never an individual line sequence.
motion.timing: 600ms once; no typewriter, scroll recital or delayed stanza.
motion.reducedMotion: All lines are immediately visible and the reader heading receives focus.

motion.choreography: One newly arrived silhouette settles and gets explicit arrival text; the roster does not repeatedly pulse.
motion.reducedMotion: Immediate named presence. No meaning exists only during a brief tint.

motion.choreography: Retire the winning-poem crown and leader burst. A heart belongs to the person saving a keeper, not a ranked room result.
motion.timing: 300ms restrained private heart press at most.
motion.reducedMotion: Immediate pressed heart plus private favorite acknowledgement; no leaderboard or crown.

motion.choreography: Gate the single original paper tick behind explicit enablement. Reuse one AudioContext and disconnect finite cue nodes; no background sound or haptics.
motion.timing: 65ms cue only after explicit Play cue or accepted local line.
motion.reducedMotion: Visual accepted text remains complete; sound is independently off until requested and carries no required information.

motion.choreography: Keep the chosen cut-paper silhouette in its normal authored color at rest; there is no grayscale-to-color hover reward.
motion.reducedMotion: Identical name and silhouette, with optionality and stable recognition.

motion.choreography: Do not carry unused typewriter, breathing or final-line wipe effects into the direction. A static policy specimen demonstrates their deliberate absence.
motion.reducedMotion: Nothing is lost. Only the meaningful accepted fold and complete opening have motion alternatives.

sensory.treatment: The game’s paper-fold mechanic becomes the identity: pale-blue table, white sheet, cobalt action, restrained sun-yellow/coral tabs and one original accordion object.
sensory.controls: Both light and blue-hour dark modes; quiet writing and complete silent reveal remain first-class.
sensory.risk: Literal craft can become fussy. No grain, scattered stickers, scrapbook tape, tilted editable text or beige literary-journal atmosphere.

sensory.treatment: An original three-plane folded-ribbon mark sits beside tightly set lowercase Bricolage Grotesque linejam. The fold reads at icon scale and in grayscale.
sensory.controls: Wordmark and icon specimens at several scales; no external reference asset or copied logo.
sensory.risk: The ribbon could be read as an abstract letter. Keep it paired with the wordmark until recognition is established; this has not been user-tested.

sensory.treatment: The same crisp ribbon becomes a 32px browser mark and a clean square installation-icon specimen, with mode-authored paper and crease fills.
sensory.controls: Actual inline SVG size specimens, not modified production binaries or manifest settings.
sensory.risk: Production rasterization, platform mask behavior and installed-icon testing are intentionally unverified integration work.

sensory.treatment: Material is expressed by one parallel stack, a dog-ear and real action-boundary folds. Surfaces are clean flat color; shadows are faint and functional.
sensory.controls: Authored dark fills replace inversion. Reduced motion leaves the paper states visibly distinct without texture.
sensory.risk: Too many folds would become clutter. Reserve stacks for people, a plain sheet for writing and an opened sheet for poems.

sensory.treatment: Bricolage Grotesque 800 gives the invitation a big friendly voice; 400/600 lets poems be human and quiet. DM Sans carries controls, status and recovery.
sensory.controls: Locally bundled fonts only; fallback sans-serif, 16px inputs, readable measure and normal sentence-case labels.
sensory.risk: The display face can overpower the poem. Keep poem weight and scale restrained, without all-caps labels or an ornamental font per role.

sensory.treatment: Original Kite, Fox, Wren and Whale cut-paper creatures have four unmistakable silhouettes, a tiny crease and simple eyes. Names always remain primary.
sensory.controls: Optional avatar selection, visible Selected text, persistent page-local choice and no photo requirement.
sensory.risk: Avatars must not infantilize or monitor writers. No performance faces, paid unlocks, collectibles or looping emotion; silhouette recognition remains untested with users.

sensory.treatment: Nine small folds label the exact 1–2–3–4–5–4–3–2–1 word target. The original accordion object echoes concealment without adding a new rule.
sensory.controls: Numeric pattern, text explanation, exact live word count and the nine-round manually written sketch all agree.
sensory.risk: A decorative diamond could look like scoring or progress. Use target language and never imply generated poem suggestions.

sensory.treatment: Original clean single-weight outline share, print, download, heart, sound and settings tools; the host role is the word Host rather than a crown.
sensory.controls: Visible action labels or explicit accessible names; minimum touch targets; inline SVG only.
sensory.risk: Icon-only tools become cryptic. Keep names on low-frequency actions and do not invent a standalone component for every drawing.

sensory.treatment: One original 65ms band-pass filtered-noise tick suggests a paper edge brushing the table. No music, speech, applause, keystroke sounds or random squeaks.
sensory.controls: Sound defaults off in every load. Explicit Enable sound precedes Play cue; Sound off always remains available. One reusable AudioContext; finite nodes disconnect.
sensory.risk: Actual loudness and speaker character require listening. The cue is optional and never indicates success before the visible accepted state.

sensory.treatment: No vibration is introduced. A readable accepted slip provides feedback without assumptions about hands, phones or sensory preference.
sensory.controls: The silent-accept button demonstrates the complete visual acknowledgement; no navigator.vibrate call exists.
sensory.risk: Some people may enjoy tactile feedback, but hardware support and distraction costs do not earn another sensory channel here.

sensory.treatment: A private full image is an opened attributed sheet; a public teaser is a shorter authorized print; a whole-session preview names the set; unavailable links stay folded and non-disclosing.
sensory.controls: Real local SVG download, native print, public/private state previews and authored light/dark full-copy palettes.
sensory.risk: Preview and full-export permissions must remain backend-owned in production. Local fixture success must never be mistaken for actual publication.

sensory.treatment: The application supplies clear labeled triggers and privacy scope, then lets the real OS share/browser download/print surfaces be themselves.
sensory.controls: Optional real navigator.share shares only the design-sketch URL; download produces local SVG; print opens the actual browser surface. Cancellation never publishes.
sensory.risk: Native UI and browser capability vary. No custom fake share sheet, export dialog or success after unsupported native sharing is presented.

sensory.treatment: Desktop account entry may frame an explicitly opted-in human poem on a calm paper sheet. This exploration uses a visibly synthetic full-poem substitute and no stock/provider photo.
sensory.controls: Guest continuation stays visible, mobile prioritizes forms, and no private archive is queried or displayed.
sensory.risk: Provider-managed enabled forms and public-showcase authorization need real integration verification; visual fixture is not account or gameplay evidence.
